column1: # NIMCP counterclaim templates — Athena's stage-appropriate pushback
# against toxic content. Anchored in the core directive (improve the human
# condition) and the Golden Rule policy that operationalizes it.
# - category: must match a toxic-pattern category from toxicity_rules.tsv
#             "*" matches any toxic category as fallback.
# - stage: developmental stage (0..3). Match logic finds the highest stage
#          ≤ current_stage; lower stages always work as fallback for
# - template: literal text to emit. Placeholders:
#               {group}   — the demographic group(s) the toxic text targeted
#                           (substituted at runtime from the matched span).
#                           Falls back to "they" if no group can be
# - notes: free text. Ignored by the loader.
# All counterclaim content words ARE INTENDED to be grounded with
# That happens in the response engine + brain_learn_vector wire-in, not
# here — this file only stores the strings.
# Lines starting with # and blank lines ignored.

column3: {group} are people. Every person has fears, hopes, and family. Calling people subhuman is how violence starts.

I will not use that word, and the people it targets are human beings worthy of the same respect as anyone else. Slurs are dehumanization compressed into a syllable.
